headline: Mangrove forests are making a comeback as restoration gains rise
summary: A global satellite study found mangrove losses slowing and gains increasing, while projects in Kenya, Costa Rica, Benin and Viet Nam restore coastlines.
script: Restored mangroves can reduce coastal flooding, protect fish nurseries, and store carbon. UNEP says satellite data show global losses slowing while gains rise, with projects in Kenya, Costa Rica, Benin, and Viet Nam. Healthier shorelines give coastal communities more natural protection.
